title: Stability of exact complexes under Artin-Rees controlled perturbation
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof iteratively corrects a vector by the perturbed image while raising its I-adic order and preserving its image. It then proves a uniform Artin-Rees bound for the perturbed map and closes exactness using Krull intersection; these quantitative coupled corrections exceed a routine application of Artin-Rees.
